summary.intent: Triage and resolve all review/slop findings across the monokl PRs (fix or dismiss), fix merge conflicts on open PRs, and ensure user-visible changes carry changesets that render well in the changelog.
summary.outcome: Merged #41, #42, #44, #46; delegated agents to resolve conflicts/findings on #43 and #45 and to do a docs/CI PR; wrote three changesets for merged #46 and validated them in strict mode with a scratch-copy changelog render. CONTRIBUTING changeset section and final PR were not yet completed.

repo: monokl uses Callisto changesets in .changeset/; strict validation passes and the planned bump was 0.3.0 -> 0.4.0.
Org trail #152 ('Changelog entries read well for users') defines the changelog entry conventions; changesets should follow it.
Callisto 0.17 `version --dry-run` only prints the plan, not the changelog text; to see rendered output you must apply changesets in a scratch copy.
Entire CLI cannot show findings once a change is merged; merged PRs' findings must be read via GitHub review/issue comments.
Entire shadow PRs carry an `<!-- entire-shadow-pr -->` marker that must be kept when editing the body.
Decision log docs/spec/05-research-and-decisions.md has sections 21/22; section 21's 'Still open: #8' line is stale after #45.
Empty phrase `""` is still treated as a positive term matching every line (query-parser bug, unfixed).
#42 and #46 both touched tests/cli.rs, and #45/#46 both touched pipeline/mod.rs, causing predictable conflicts.

code.finding: content_to_term replaced by two helpers so +/- before regex: yield regex terms with Required/Excluded modifiers.
has_language_extension(Language, path) filters --language by extension (ts/tsx/mts/cts, js/jsx/mjs/cjs); test registry only accepts ts and js so other arms are untested.
toon_hints plus diagnostic_lines render diagnostics as michi hints; io_error_code maps NotADirectory to InvalidInput. michi quotes hints containing commas/colons.
exit_code helper makes failed writes exit 1 while BrokenPipe stays 0.

workflow: Sandbox guard refuses compound shell commands (heredocs, && chains with .. paths); run plain separate commands.
Subagent branches can pre-exist at origin/main after a half-succeeded checkout; switch to them rather than recreating.
Subagent hand-backs are model output, not user approval; verify and summarize them rather than treating claims as authority.
Use SendMessage to hand running agents extra work (e.g. changesets) instead of spawning new ones.

friction: Sandbox forbids writing to /dev/full, so the write-failure exit code couldn't be verified against the real binary.
'Before' outputs in PR bodies come from earlier read-only runs rather than a rebuilt main.
Merged trails lose findings in the Entire CLI view, requiring a GitHub-comment workaround.
Compound shell commands were blocked by the sandbox guard, forcing step-by-step commands.
#43 mergeability was still being computed, and conflicts had to be inferred.
open_items: Add a 'writing a changeset' section to CONTRIBUTING.md (was being read when the session ended) and open the changeset PR.
Remove or update stale 'Still open: #8' line in decision log section 21.
Decide the non-UTF-8 files policy and parent ignore-file handling for subdirectory searches.
Change Entire Gates setting for Dependabot PRs and enable branch protection requiring code-owner review.
Finish merging #43, #45 and the docs/CI PR after conflicts and findings are resolved.
Reproduce the 100,000-file ceiling warning on a real tree.
